question: Your sibling accidentally broke your favourite vase. Which of the following idioms might you use to tell them not to worry about it?
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1 (Don't cry over spilt milk!)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Don't cry over spilt milk!"** means that there is no use worrying about something that has already happened and cannot be changed. (जो हुआ है उसे लेकर परेशान होने का कोई फायदा नहीं है।)

 
 
• **Example:** After losing the game, she reminded herself not to cry over spilt milk and focused on preparing for the next match.
 
 
 
• **"Broken Vase"** refers to an item that is physically damaged or shattered. (टूटा हुआ फूलदान)
 
 
• **Example:** The broken vase lay scattered on the floor, but she chose to forgive her sibling and move on.
 
 
 
• Hence, the idiom **"Don't cry over spilt milk!"** is appropriate in this situation as it encourages letting go of minor accidents or mishaps.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 (Don't cry over spilt milk!)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Shallow brooks are noisy** (छिछले नाले शोर करते हैं): This idiom implies that people with little knowledge often talk the most or make unnecessary noise.

 
 
• **Example:** His constant interruptions proved the saying "shallow brooks are noisy" to be true.
 
 
 
• **Bite the bullet** (मुश्किल को सहन करना): This idiom means to face a painful or unpleasant situation with courage.
 
 
• **Example:** She had to bite the bullet and tell her manager about the mistake she made.
 
 
 
• **You're walking on air** (बहुत खुश होना): This idiom refers to feeling extremely happy or ecstatic.
 
 
• **Example:** After hearing the news of her promotion, she felt like she was walking on air.
